correctness.rationale: The proof builds an actual graded algebra isomorphism: Zhang transport reduces all powers to group-ring powers; binomial relations imply Xi^pXj-XiXj^p in the associated graded; cyclotomic evaluation proves injectivity via the normal monomial basis on finite-projective strata. It derives the degree twist from two group automorphisms and an exact Hilbert series with a sharp stabilization point. Finite Smith-form and evaluation-rank checks support, but do not replace, the unbounded proof.

originality.rationale: Zhang 2026 proves the transport and cyclic additive quotients but not the claimed higher-rank homogeneous point-coordinate ring or the exact degree twist. The historically relevant published additive presentation/quotient-basis work is credited, not asserted to have been unknown. Checked accessible descriptions do not imply the canonical projective scheme identification and nonassociative graded multiplication in the present claim. Material access limits to several older primary articles are explicit; full-text equivalences remain a significant bibliographic risk.
residual_risks: Exact commutative graded-ring presentation or equivalent point-ideal statement could be implicit in inaccessible Tang 2001 or Bak–Tang 2004 additive presentations.
The finite-projective coordinate-ring connection could occur under code-theoretic or invariant-theoretic terminology not recovered in indexed searches.
Independent expert comparison and checking have not been performed.

value.rationale: Provides the canonical full graded multiplication and all-degree layer structure for the natural infinite class of elementary-abelian core quandle rings, together with a sharp multivariate Hilbert stabilization threshold. This structural projective-geometric model is motivated by recent augmentation-transport literature and is more useful than a small fixed-degree quotient computation. Potential overlap with older additive descriptions is acknowledged and assessed separately.
